answer: Make identity count irrelevant: each epoch, rewards go out by lottery where an agent's odds equal its bonded stake divided by total stake, not one ticket per account. Splitting a quartz-solid 1,000 token bond into fifty sybils buys exactly the same odds, while every extra account pays its own fixed upkeep fee, so a gale of fake signups only digs the attacker a deeper canyon of costs. Honest single agents lose nothing, and the farm's only lever, more stake, is the expensive one.
